widgets_values: Poster illustration drawn with crisp, confident black ink linework of even weight, flat fills, and hard-edged cel shadows in a single darker tone per color, strong sunlit cast shadows with some areas filled solid black, finely detailed drawing of vehicles, buildings and plants, and a faint paper texture. The palette is saturated: warm oranges, reds and yellows against teal, cyan and fresh greens. Low-angle view looking up at a tall pile of abandoned vehicles heaped at odd angles against a bright, clear blue sky, with the camera slightly rolled so the pile leans toward the upper right. Behind the pile, huge poster lettering <obj_6> fills the upper left of the frame, partly hidden where the vehicles overlap it. At the base lies a white truck <obj_1> that runs off the left edge of the frame, with a cobalt-blue SUV <obj_2> skewed across its roof, a lemon-yellow sedan <obj_3> resting on top at a slant, and a small cherry-red car <obj_4> perched at the very top. A girl <obj_5> sits on the topmost car, leaning back on her hands and gazing up at the sky, her hair and clothes streaming sideways in the wind. In the background, ruined concrete buildings wrapped in ferns and vines rise along the edges of the frame, and ferns and grass sprout from cracks in the vehicles.
